tour_type.morning: ⛪ Lisbon Cathedral (Sé): Start your morning in Alfama’s oldest corner — stone walls, narrow alleys and peaceful early vibes. → | 🌄 Miradouro de Santa Luzia: One of Lisbon’s most iconic tiled terraces with pink flowers, river views and perfect morning light. → | 🚋 Alfama Walk: Wander tiny streets, colorful houses, laundry lines, and local artisan corners — Lisbon charm at its finest. → | ☕ Alfama Café Break: Try a pastel de nata with juice or coffee in a small traditional café.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏰 Belém Tower (Exterior Walk): Riverside paths, palm-lined views and Portugal’s Age of Discoveries vibe. → | 🏛️ Jerónimos Monastery (Exterior): Stunning gothic-renaissance details — even from outside it’s unbelievable. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Portuguese Flavors: Try veggie-friendly caldo verde, grilled veggies, salads, bread with olive oil and (of course) pastel de nata. → | 🌊 Belém Riverside Promenade: Chill walk along the Tagus River with wide open water views.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Miradouro da Senhora do Monte: One of the highest viewpoints in Lisbon — warm colors over rooftops, hills and the river. Epic golden-hour scenery.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Praça do Comércio Night Walk (non-alcoholic): Soft lights, wide open square, calm river breeze and dessert shops. A clean, safe and peaceful way to end the day.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Sé Cathedral: Lisbon’s oldest church with calm morning atmosphere. → | Santa Luzia Viewpoint: Tiled terrace with flowers and river views. → | Alfama Walk: Narrow alleys, colorful houses and local charm. → | Alfama Café: Pastel de nata + cozy break.; Afternoon: Belém Tower: Riverside fortress with iconic silhouettes. → | Jerónimos Monastery (Exterior): Stunning gothic details. → | Portuguese Lunch: Caldo verde, grilled veggies, salads. → | Belém Riverside Walk: Wide river views and fresh air.; Sunset: Senhora do Monte Viewpoint: Huge panorama over the city.; Night: Praça do Comércio Walk: Soft lights, dessert shops and calm waterfront vibe.

tour_type.morning: ⛪ Porto Cathedral (Sé) Exterior: Start your morning above the city — stone walls, giant arches and huge views over Porto’s rooftops. → | 🏰 Bishop’s Palace Lookout (Exterior): Peaceful, open terraces overlooking the river. → | 🏘️ Ribeira Old Town Walk: Bright narrow streets, river vibes, colorful houses and tiled façades. → | ☕ Ribeira Riverside Café: Pastel de nata, fruit, or iced coffee right next to the Douro River.
tour_type.afternoon: 🌉 Dom Luís I Bridge Walk (Upper Level): One of Porto’s most iconic views — wide panoramas of the city and river. → | 🏛️ Miragaia District: Colorful houses, tiny streets, artisan workshops and relaxed energy. → | 🍽️ Porto-Style Lunch: Try veggie-friendly caldo verde, roasted veggies, rice dishes, francesinha-style vegetarian options, salads or Mediterranean bowls. → | 🎨 Rua das Flores Art Street: Cute boutiques, street art corners and handcrafted items.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Jardim do Morro: Legendary Porto sunset — golden light over Ribeira, the bridge and the glowing Douro River. Super chill atmosphere.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Gaia Riverside Promenade (non-alcoholic): Ice cream, waffles, smoothies and soft lights reflecting on the river. Safe, calm and perfect for a night walk.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Ribeira Riverside: Colorful houses along the Douro River. → | Dom Luís I Bridge (Upper Level): Epic river and city panoramas. → | Porto Cathedral (Exterior): Stone façade with hilltop views. → | Sé District Café: Relaxed morning drink.; Afternoon: São Bento Station (Interior allowed): Famous azulejo tile scenes. → | Clérigos Tower (Exterior): Iconic baroque silhouette. → | Livraria Lello (Exterior): Pretty neo-Gothic façade. → | Porto Lunch: Veggie francesinha, soups, salads.; Sunset: Jardim do Morro: Golden hour overlooking the river and old town.; Night: Ribeira Promenade: Ice cream, crepes and peaceful riverside lights.

tour_type.morning: ⛪ Braga Cathedral (Sé de Braga) Exterior: Start the day with Portugal’s oldest cathedral — peaceful courtyards, stone arches and morning calm. → | 🏘️ Old Town Streets: Bright facades, tiled buildings, little shops and slow-paced Braga charm. → | 🌿 Santa Barbara Garden: One of the most beautiful gardens in northern Portugal — flowers, arches and colorful patterns everywhere. → | ☕ Old-Town Café Break: Pastel de nata, fruit, or a fresh juice in a relaxed square.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏞️ Bom Jesus do Monte (Exterior & Viewpoints): Famous baroque staircase, lakes, gardens and the incredible hilltop view over Braga — totally iconic even without entering buildings. → | 🎠 Funicular Exterior Walk: One of the world’s oldest water-powered funiculars — a cool photo and chill viewpoint area. → | 🍽️ Minho-Style Lunch: Veggie-friendly caldo verde, rice dishes, roasted veggies, salads and northern Portuguese flavors. → | 🌿 Bom Jesus Forest Trails: Calm nature paths with shade, flowers and scenic corners.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Sameiro Sanctuary Overlook (Exterior): Huge panoramic viewpoint with warm light over hills, forests and Braga’s lights turning on.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Avenida da Liberdade Night Walk (non-alcoholic): Soft fountains, quiet cafés, dessert spots, and safe evening atmosphere in Braga’s calm center.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Braga Cathedral (Exterior): Oldest cathedral in Portugal. → | Historical Center Walk: Stone alleys, plazas and cafés. → | Biscainhos Garden (Exterior): Decorative gardens and calm atmosphere. → | Old-Town Café: Chill morning break.; Afternoon: Bom Jesus do Monte (Exterior & Staircases): Hilltop sanctuary with dramatic stairways. → | Panoramic Terrace: Scenic views over Braga’s hills. → | Braga Lunch: Veggie soups, pastries, salads. → | Garden Walks Around the Sanctuary: Fresh air and greenery.; Sunset: Sameiro Sanctuary Viewpoint: Soft golden light over rolling landscapes.; Night: Avenida da Liberdade Stroll: Dessert shops, fountains and calm evening vibes.
